note: Wooded southern-Iowa park near Davis City with a 64-acre lake (rowboats and electric motors only). The modern campground is a set of long pull-throughs in a clearing in the woods, about 800 m from the lake; the non-electric campground is separate, and there are primitive equestrian and youth-group sites too. No daily Iowa park-entry fee. --Claude
summary: Hookups 50 A (no sewer), 47 sites (27 electric + 20 non-electric) to 85 ft with pull-throughs, facilities and booking (100% reservable year round, 3-month window, 10 pm day-of cutoff) confirmed from DNR/ReserveAmerica; fees unchanged (match RA 2026-27 rates: $10/$12 non-electric, $18/$22 electric). Not waterfront confirmed. PIN ~390 m off. Note trimmed.
flags: WATERFRONT: not waterfront confirmed. ReserveAmerica tags every site 'Near Water - no'. On imagery the modern campground sits in a forest clearing ~800 m east of the nearest arm of the 64-acre lake; the only water beside it is a small pond of roughly 0.3-0.5 ha just east of the loops (imagery estimate; Overpass not used), under the 5-acre pond line. No view.

PIN: stored 40.59722,-93.75222 is in unbroken forest ~390 m NE of the modern (electric) campground. Correct to ~40.5953,-93.7560, the centre of its loops on Esri imagery (ReserveAmerica publishes no GIS points here). The non-electric campground's own location could not be picked out on imagery.
FIT: every listed site takes 30 ft or more (non-electric sites '30 Back-In'), so the $10/$12 non-electric base stands.
